question:
Find the shortest route from S to E in the lowest movement cost.
One move = one step up, down, left or right. Walls (#) block your path. Coordinates are 1-indexed (row 1 is top row, column 1 is leftmost column). Mud (~) tiles cost 2 moves to enter. Pass through checkpoints 1 then 2 in that order before reaching E. One-way cells (arrows) can only be entered and exited in the direction of the arrow. Gate G stays locked until checkpoint 1 is collected.
~~.~..vS
2#.~#...
E#G###.#
.#...##.
..1.....
...v...#
...###..
.######.
hints: The gate G must be unlocked by visiting checkpoint 1 before proceeding to E. Additionally, the one-way cell at row 1, col 7 must be navigated carefully as it restricts movement.
From start cell S at row 1, col 8, move down toward row 2, col 8.
